title: For a changed non-test file whose base overlay passes the whole package, say so in the Base overlays section, so the reviewer sees at once which changed sites have no test

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261126-021913-1034, project ork, item S617:

For a changed non-test file whose base overlay passes the whole package, say so in the Base overlays section, so the reviewer sees at once which changed sites have no test

Evidence: overlay-1.json (handlers.go) and overlay-3.json (speccheck_state.go) both passed ./internal/daemon in full
